Name: Deluxe Journal Continued
Author: kauf0
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029797-1433156582.png[/img][/center]

[center][url=https://dalink.to/kauf0][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029878-1278522707.png[/img][/url]
Like it? An [b]endorsement[/b] helps other farmers find it.[/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029835-1798372522.gif[/img][/center]
[size=4][b][color=#b4d799]New in 1.5.0[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Slay monster tasks.[/b] Track kills of one monster or a whole Adventurer's Guild goal, like "kill 1000 slimes". Idea by Celize.[/*]
[*][b]Quest Journal integration.[/b] Your tasks show up in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46966]Quest Journal[/url] when both mods are installed. Contributed by RafiaBee.[/*]
[*][b]Overlay text size.[/b] Each overlay gets its own text size, 60 to 100%, on the Overlays page.[/*]
[*][b]Recolor support.[/b] Recolors can use Content Patcher now, so they survive mod updates.[/*]
[/list]Plus a pile of fixes, including farmhands' tasks finally getting saved in multiplayer. Full list in the Changelogs tab.


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029847-158337532.gif[/img][/center]
[size=4][b][color=#b4d799]Tasks[/color][/b][/size]
Write it like you'd say it: "Buy 20 parsnip seeds", "Gift Abigail an amethyst", "Kill 10 slimes". The journal works out what you mean and ticks it off when you actually do it.
[quote][b]Smart Add not picking it up?[/b] Hit Enter or the lightbulb to Smart Add. The OK button always makes a plain task that you tick yourself.
Commands come from the mod's translation: English by default, while French, Polish, Portuguese and Chinese have their own (the new kill/slay commands are English everywhere for now). Item, villager and building names have to match how your game spells them, in your game's language. You can always set the task up by hand with the wrench in the add menu.[/quote][b]All English commands:[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Buy:[/b] buy, purchase, get[/*]
[*][b]Sell:[/b] sell, ship[/*]
[*][b]Collect:[/b] collect, chop, harvest, gather, forage, fish, catch, mine, dig, find, search, retrieve, get, make[/*]
[*][b]Craft:[/b] craft, cook, create, make, get[/*]
[*][b]Gift:[/b] gift, give[/*]
[*][b]Build:[/b] build, construct, upgrade, buy, purchase, get[/*]
[*][b]Farm animal:[/b] buy, purchase, get[/*]
[*][b]Tool upgrade:[/b] upgrade, buy, purchase, get[/*]
[*][b]Slay:[/b] slay, kill, defeat, hunt[/*]
[/list]Shared words like get, buy or make are sorted out by what comes after them: an item, an animal, a building or a tool.[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029854-1793190207.gif[/img][/center]
Give a task a renewal (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or every N days after you finish it) and it comes back on its own. Group tasks under headers: tasks under a header take its color unless you give them their own. Drag to reorder.


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029861-348506114.gif[/img][/center]
[size=4][b][color=#b4d799]Notes and overlays[/color][/b][/size]
Notes are for everything that isn't a task, and they save on their own, even if you quit before bed.
Overlays keep your list on screen. Switch one on in the Overlays tab, press Edit-Mode at the bottom to drag and resize it, and set its text size and colors there. Press O to show or hide them (locked overlays stay put).
[i]The zoom boxes in the GIFs are added for this page only.[/i]

[size=4][b][color=#b4d799]Plays nice with[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer and split-screen.[/b] Everyone who wants a journal needs the mod, and the host needs it too so farmhands' tasks get saved.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26194]QuickSave[/url]:[/b] tasks keep counting after a quickload.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46966]Quest Journal[/url][/b] by RafiaBee.[/*]
[*][b]Recolors:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19724]Earthy Interface[/url] by KickingBadger, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32169]Earthy Recolor[/url] by CountessSage, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51206]Cat Valley[/url] by mmitski. These replace the image files, so install them again after updating Deluxe Journal. Making one? Use Content Patcher with the asset names below and it survives updates.[/*]
[*][b]Translations:[/b] Français, Polski, Português, 中文. Text added in 1.5.0 shows in English there until the translations catch up. Spanish keeps getting asked for: if you can help, the i18n file is [url=https://github.com/kauf0/DeluxeJournal/tree/master/i18n]on GitHub[/url].[/*]
[/list][spoiler]Edit these with Content Patcher (replacing the files still works too), then post your recolor in the comments and I'll add it to the list:
[list]
[*]Mods/MolsonCAD.DeluxeJournal/UI[/*]
[*]Mods/MolsonCAD.DeluxeJournal/AnimalIcons[/*]
[*]Mods/MolsonCAD.DeluxeJournal/BuildingIcons[/*]
[*]Mods/MolsonCAD.DeluxeJournal/ColoredTaskMask[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b][color=#b4d799]Install[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.9+ and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0+. Tested on SV 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2.[/*]
[*]Unzip into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Open it like the normal journal: the journal button or F.[/*]
[*]Coming from the original Deluxe Journal? Remove it first (copy its config.json over if you changed any options). Your tasks, notes and overlays carry over on their own.[/*]
[*]Only download from Nexus or GitHub. Copies on other sites aren't mine and might be old or worse.[/*]
[/list][b]Found a bug?[/b] Post it in the Bugs tab with your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]), your game's language, and a screenshot if it's something visual. Without the log I'm mostly guessing.

[center][url=https://dalink.to/kauf0][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43805/43805-1792029874-1238154822.png[/img][/url]
Can't tip? An endorsement or a good bug report helps just as much.[/center]
